FR · Not Found · geb.fr zoominfo.com/c/geb-sas/372743980 GEB SAS is a historic French chemical manufacturing company established in 1860.
They specialize in formulating and producing essential sealing solutions, adhesives, and PVC glues.
The family-owned business primarily provides high-quality maintenance and installation products for plumbing and heating professionals.
